attributes.bodyCopy:
Christmas trees, the centrepiece of the festive season

Bring all the nostalgia and memory making back year after year with a beautiful Christmas tree from our range. Make memories with your children decorating the tree before the big day, and find options that suit your home’s style while bringing all the joy of the season with it. Browse different sizes to fit neatly into your room, from compact 3ft trees that can sit on a table to towering 12ft models that stretch from floor to ceiling.

Pre-lit Christmas trees save you the faff of untangling wires, providing a tree that’s bright and consistently lit every time you pull it out. Pair your stunning tree with tasteful ornaments, adding a sparkle to your home to make the long winter nights filled with joy. Different coloured options make your Christmas decorating even more customisable, allowing you to pair your tree with your home, or mimic the look of new fallen snow on the branches of your tree.

Durable materials and easy storage mean your tree will last for years. Easy, folding branches make setting up a breeze, so you can get down to decorating in no time. Plus, you’ll never have to worry about dropped needles or a risk of fire. Find the Christmas tree that gets you in the spirit of the holiday in our range, and order online today for fast home delivery.

Get into the festive spirit with a Christmas tree full of joy and festive cheer thanks to delightful baubles that sparkle and shine. Find classic red and green baubles to adorn your home for the big day, or opt for more varied colours to add some modern fun to the tree. attributes.bodyCopy:
Give your old tree a refresh with Christmas tree decorations

No Christmas tree is complete without a selection of sparkling baubles, twinkling tinsel and standout sets of lights. With a variety of colours, textures, and styles, our range of Christmas decorations offer a low-effort way to refresh your festive decor year after year without replacing the tree itself. Simply update your old colour palette or add textures like glass, velvet, or wood to give your tree a premium look while staying within budget.

Add texture, colour and personality to your Christmas tree

Choose from shatterproof baubles in a variety of sizes and finishes to create a coordinated theme, from navy-and-silver combinations for modern interiors to more traditional festive styles. You can even personalise selected baubles with names, milestones, or meaningful messages for a unique touch of your personality. Add playful character ornaments and novelty designs, from gingerbread men and hanging dog houses to Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets-inspired flying car decorations. Fill the gaps in your tree with candle-style lights, velvet bows, and decorative beaded garlands to add texture and depth. Finish the look with a star tree topper for a polished festive display.

Taking the faff out of festivities from styling to storage

For a professionally styled tree, aim for around 60 to 80 decorations on a 6ft tree to create balanced coverage. Start with larger baubles near the bottom and work upwards, spacing different textures and finishes evenly throughout the tree. After the festive season, store decorations in their original packaging or in divided storage boxes to help prevent scratches or tangling, keeping them ready to use again next year.

attributes.bodyCopy:
Give your old tree a refresh with Christmas tree decorations

No Christmas tree is complete without a selection of sparkling baubles, twinkling tinsel and standout sets of lights. With a variety of colours, textures, and styles, our range of Christmas decorations offer a low-effort way to refresh your festive decor year after year without replacing the tree itself. Simply update your old colour palette or add textures like glass, velvet, or wood to give your tree a premium look while staying within budget.

Add texture, colour and personality to your Christmas tree

Choose from shatterproof baubles in a variety of sizes and finishes to create a coordinated theme, from navy-and-silver combinations for modern interiors to more traditional festive styles. You can even personalise selected baubles with names, milestones, or meaningful messages for a unique touch of your personality. Add playful character ornaments and novelty designs, from gingerbread men and hanging dog houses to Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets-inspired flying car decorations. Fill the gaps in your tree with candle-style lights, velvet bows, and decorative beaded garlands to add texture and depth. Finish the look with a star tree topper for a polished festive display.

Taking the faff out of festivities from styling to storage

For a professionally styled tree, aim for around 60 to 80 decorations on a 6ft tree to create balanced coverage. Start with larger baubles near the bottom and work upwards, spacing different textures and finishes evenly throughout the tree. After the festive season, store decorations in their original packaging or in divided storage boxes to help prevent scratches or tangling, keeping them ready to use again next year.

Get garlands with lights for easy Christmas decor

Enhance your Christmas decor with minimal effort by bringing home faux garlands with built-in lights. Use them to decorate your staircases, mantelpieces, or dining tables, and instantly add a festive glow to your home. Plus, faux foliage means no mess of real needles or dried-up leaves, making decoration easy and reusable for a long time.

Greenery with lights, for the ultimate festive decor

Plus, if you choose pre-lit battery-operated designs, all you have to think about is where your garlands will look best. attributes.bodyCopy:
Protect your floor whilst enjoying the festive view with Christmas tree skirts and stands

Practicality doesn’t need to come at a cost to the vibrant and cosy decor you want to create at Christmas time. With these Christmas tree skirts and stands you’ll be able to add a decorative base to your holiday centrepiece whilst ensuring your floors don’t suffer from scratches or your tree doesn’t topple over.

With various styles and themes available at Argos, your tree will have a base that adds the seasonal spirit that nicely complements the stunning decorations you assemble on your tree. There’s options that cater to different sized trees, so no matter how much space you have and whether it’s for a real or artificial tree you’ll find a skirt or stand for you.

Durable materials to withstand Christmas excitement

The whole family loves to get in the Christmas spirit, but to ensure your tree survives overly exuberant kids and pets these stands and skirts use reliable materials to keep not only this years’ tree but trees for many years to come safe and protected.

These products are easy to clean and make tree maintenance that much more simple, with stands giving you a solid space to water the tree to ensure it looks healthy and vibrant all through the Christmas period.

The materials used are lightweight making them easily adjustable, so when you want to play around with the layout before the family turns up for the festivities you’ll be able to do so with ease.

For a solid and reliable foundation that doesn’t compromise on style, explore the range of Christmas tree skirts and stands on Argos in time for the festive season!

attributes.bodyCopy:
Make your home shine with outdoor Christmas decorations

Share your festive spirit with your neighbourhood by setting up outdoor Christmas decorations in your front garden or driveway. From acrylic Santa figures to reindeer and lights with IP ratings that can handle the winter weather, these decorations will continue to shine through rain, frost, and snow.

Festive fun without the faff

With connectable features, you can connect multiple light sets to a single mains power source for a seamless display. Choose warm white lights for a classic, traditional look, or opt for multicoloured characters to reflect your unique festive personality. Plus, these LED lights stay bright while utilising less power, so you can rely on the same set year after year. Battery-operated options also let you decorate areas without easy access to power, such as fences or patio areas. To keep your 3D figures in place on those windy winter days, secure them down with stakes and tethers so your Santa doesn’t take a trip down the street. 

Professional-looking Christmas decor without the pro-level price tag

Line your front path to guide guests safely to your door, place festive characters on the lawn for a fun display, or hang shimmering lights along the gutters and hedges. With our range of outdoor Christmas decorations, you can create a professional-looking display without the high cost.
